content_text: Your location photo looks good. Nice large windows. When you are shooting somewhere like that its a matter of scheduling your shots so that you don’t suddenly get a shaft of sunlight in the middle of an. otherwise soft scene. The overheads could help, if you want to soften the look but I might just leave them off and use small daylight balanced lamps if really necessary.
